src: Considering the situation of globally pandemic of COVID-19, to decrease the risk of influenza virus infection and minimize the impact on COVID-19 prevention and control, we recommend the following priority for seasonal influenza vaccination: healthcare workers, including clinical doctors and nurses, public health professionals, quarantine professionals; vulnerable groups living in nursing homes or welfare homes and staffs who take care those vulnerable groups; people work or stay in high population density places, such as teachers and students in kindergartens, primary and secondary school, prisoners and staffs of prisons; other high risk group of influenza, including adults ≥60 years of age, children aged 6-59 months, persons with specific chronic diseases, the family members and caregivers of infants <6 months of age, and pregnant women or women who plan to become pregnant during the influenza season.
tgt: 考虑到新冠疫情全球流行的形势，为降低流感病毒感染的风险，最大限度地减少对新冠疫情防控的影响，我们建议季节性流感疫苗接种的优先事项如下：医护人员，包括临床医生和护士、公共卫生专业人员、检疫专业人员；居住在养老院或福利院的弱势群体和照顾这些弱势群体的工作人员；在人口密度高的地方工作或居住的人，如幼儿园、中小学的教师和学生、监狱的囚犯和工作人员；其他流感高危群体，包括≥60岁的成年人、6-59个月的儿童、患有特定慢性病的人、6个月以下婴儿的家庭成员和护理人员，以及孕妇或计划在流感季节怀孕的妇女。
ref: 考虑到全球 COVID-19 大流行的情势，为了降低流感病毒感染的风险，最大限度地减少对 COVID-19 预防和控制的影响，我们建议季节性流感疫苗的优先接种对象如下：医护人员，包括临床医生和护士、公共卫生专业人员、检疫专业人员；生活在养老院或福利院的弱势群体以及照顾这些弱势群体的工作人员；在高人口密度场所工作或停留的人员，如幼儿园、中小学教师和学生、囚犯和监狱工作人员；其他高风险流感群体，包括 60 岁以上的成年人、 6-59 个月的儿童、特定慢性疾病患者、6 个月以下婴儿的家庭成员和照顾者、孕妇及计划在流感季节期间怀孕的女士。

src: Considering the situation of globally pandemic of COVID-19, to decrease the risk of influenza virus infection and minimize the impact on COVID-19 prevention and control, we recommend the following priority for seasonal influenza vaccination: healthcare workers, including clinical doctors and nurses, public health professionals, quarantine professionals; vulnerable groups living in nursing homes or welfare homes and staffs who take care those vulnerable groups; people work or stay in high population density places, such as teachers and students in kindergartens, primary and secondary school, prisoners and staffs of prisons; other high risk group of influenza, including adults ≥60 years of age, children aged 6-59 months, persons with specific chronic diseases, the family members and caregivers of infants <6 months of age, and pregnant women or women who plan to become pregnant during the influenza season.
tgt: 考虑到COVID-19全球大流行的情况，为了降低流感病毒感染的风险并将对COVID-19防控的影响降至最低，我们建议季节性流感疫苗接种的重点如下：医护人员，包括临床医生和护士，公共卫生专业人员，检疫专业人员；生活在养老院或福利院的弱势群体和照顾这些弱势群体的工作人员；在人口密度高的场所工作或居住的人，如幼儿园、中小学校的教师和学生、服刑人员和监狱工作人员；其他流感高危人群，包括≥60岁的成年人、6-59个月的儿童、患有特定慢性疾病的人、<6个月婴儿的家庭成员和照顾者、孕妇或计划在流感季节怀孕的妇女。
ref: 考虑到全球 COVID-19 大流行的情势，为了降低流感病毒感染的风险，最大限度地减少对 COVID-19 预防和控制的影响，我们建议季节性流感疫苗的优先接种对象如下：医护人员，包括临床医生和护士、公共卫生专业人员、检疫专业人员；生活在养老院或福利院的弱势群体以及照顾这些弱势群体的工作人员；在高人口密度场所工作或停留的人员，如幼儿园、中小学教师和学生、囚犯和监狱工作人员；其他高风险流感群体，包括 60 岁以上的成年人、 6-59 个月的儿童、特定慢性疾病患者、6 个月以下婴儿的家庭成员和照顾者、孕妇及计划在流感季节期间怀孕的女士。

考虑到全球 COVID-19 大流行的情势，为了降低流感病毒感染的风险，最大限度地减少对 COVID-19 预防和控制的影响，我们建议季节性流感疫苗的优先接种对象如下：医护人员，包括临床医生和护士，公共卫生专业人员，检疫专业人员；生活在养老院或福利院的弱势群体以及照顾这些弱势群体的工作人员；在高人口密度场所工作或停留的人员，如幼儿园，中小学的教师和学生，囚犯和监狱工作人员；其他高风险流感群体，包括 60 岁以上的成年人， 6-59 个月的儿童，特定慢性疾病患者， 6 个月以下婴儿的家庭成员和照顾者，孕妇及计划在流感季节期间怀孕的女士。

src: Considering the situation of globally pandemic of COVID-19, to decrease the risk of influenza virus infection and minimize the impact on COVID-19 prevention and control, we recommend the following priority for seasonal influenza vaccination: healthcare workers, including clinical doctors and nurses, public health professionals, quarantine professionals; vulnerable groups living in nursing homes or welfare homes and staffs who take care those vulnerable groups; people work or stay in high population density places, such as teachers and students in kindergartens, primary and secondary school, prisoners and staffs of prisons; other high risk group of influenza, including adults ≥60 years of age, children aged 6-59 months, persons with specific chronic diseases, the family members and caregivers of infants <6 months of age, and pregnant women or women who plan to become pregnant during the influenza season.
tgt: 考虑到全球流行的COVID-19的情况，为了降低流感病毒感染的风险，尽量减少对COVID-19预防和控制的影响，我们建议季节性流感疫苗接种的重点是：医护人员，包括临床医生和护士，公共卫生专业人员，检疫专业人员；生活在养老院、福利院的弱势群体和照顾弱势群体的工作人员；在人口密度较高的场所工作或停留的人员，如幼儿园、中小学师生、罪犯、监狱工作人员等；其他流感高危人群，包括成人≥60岁、6-59个月的儿童、患有特定慢性病的人、6个月以下婴儿的家庭成员和照顾者、孕妇或计划在流感季节怀孕的妇女。
ref: 考虑到全球 COVID-19 大流行的情势，为了降低流感病毒感染的风险，最大限度地减少对 COVID-19 预防和控制的影响，我们建议季节性流感疫苗的优先接种对象如下：医护人员，包括临床医生和护士、公共卫生专业人员、检疫专业人员；生活在养老院或福利院的弱势群体以及照顾这些弱势群体的工作人员；在高人口密度场所工作或停留的人员，如幼儿园、中小学教师和学生、囚犯和监狱工作人员；其他高风险流感群体，包括 60 岁以上的成年人、 6-59 个月的儿童、特定慢性疾病患者、6 个月以下婴儿的家庭成员和照顾者、孕妇及计划在流感季节期间怀孕的女士。

src: Considering the situation of globally pandemic of COVID-19, to decrease the risk of influenza virus infection and minimize the impact on COVID-19 prevention and control, we recommend the following priority for seasonal influenza vaccination: healthcare workers, including clinical doctors and nurses, public health professionals, quarantine professionals; vulnerable groups living in nursing homes or welfare homes and staffs who take care those vulnerable groups; people work or stay in high population density places, such as teachers and students in kindergartens, primary and secondary school, prisoners and staffs of prisons; other high risk group of influenza, including adults ≥60 years of age, children aged 6-59 months, persons with specific chronic diseases, the family members and caregivers of infants <6 months of age, and pregnant women or women who plan to become pregnant during the influenza season.
tgt: 考虑到全球新型冠状病毒肺炎大流行的情况，为了降低流感病毒感染的风险并尽量减少对新型冠状病毒肺炎预防和控制的影响，我们建议季节性流感疫苗接种的以下优先事项：医护人员，包括临床医生和护士，公共卫生专业人员，检疫专业人员；生活在养老院或福利院的弱势群体以及照顾这些弱势群体的工作人员；人们在人口密度高的地方工作或逗留，如幼儿园，小学和中学的师生，囚犯和监狱工作人员；其他高危人群，包括成年人≥60岁，6-59个月的儿童，特定慢性病患者，6个月以下婴儿的家庭成员和照顾者，以及计划在流感季节怀孕的孕妇或妇女。
ref: 考虑到全球 COVID-19 大流行的情势，为了降低流感病毒感染的风险，最大限度地减少对 COVID-19 预防和控制的影响，我们建议季节性流感疫苗的优先接种对象如下：医护人员，包括临床医生和护士、公共卫生专业人员、检疫专业人员；生活在养老院或福利院的弱势群体以及照顾这些弱势群体的工作人员；在高人口密度场所工作或停留的人员，如幼儿园、中小学教师和学生、囚犯和监狱工作人员；其他高风险流感群体，包括 60 岁以上的成年人、 6-59 个月的儿童、特定慢性疾病患者、6 个月以下婴儿的家庭成员和照顾者、孕妇及计划在流感季节期间怀孕的女士。

src: Considering the situation of globally pandemic of COVID-19, to decrease the risk of influenza virus infection and minimize the impact on COVID-19 prevention and control, we recommend the following priority for seasonal influenza vaccination: healthcare workers, including clinical doctors and nurses, public health professionals, quarantine professionals; vulnerable groups living in nursing homes or welfare homes and staffs who take care those vulnerable groups; people work or stay in high population density places, such as teachers and students in kindergartens, primary and secondary school, prisoners and staffs of prisons; other high risk group of influenza, including adults ≥60 years of age, children aged 6-59 months, persons with specific chronic diseases, the family members and caregivers of infants <6 months of age, and pregnant women or women who plan to become pregnant during the influenza season.
tgt: 考虑到新冠肺炎大流行的全球形势，为了降低流感病毒感染的风险，最大限度地减少对新冠肺炎防控的影响，我们建议季节性流感疫苗接种的优先事项如下：医护人员，包括临床医生和护士、公共卫生专业人员、检疫专业人员；居住在疗养院或福利院的弱势群体和照顾这些弱势群体的工作人员；在人口密度高的地方工作或停留的人，如幼儿园、小学和中学的教师和学生、囚犯和监狱工作人员；其他流感高危群体，包括≥60岁的成人、6-59个月的儿童、患有特定慢性病的人、6个月以下婴儿的家庭成员和护理人员，以及孕妇或计划在流感季节怀孕的妇女。
ref: 考虑到全球 COVID-19 大流行的情势，为了降低流感病毒感染的风险，最大限度地减少对 COVID-19 预防和控制的影响，我们建议季节性流感疫苗的优先接种对象如下：医护人员，包括临床医生和护士、公共卫生专业人员、检疫专业人员；生活在养老院或福利院的弱势群体以及照顾这些弱势群体的工作人员；在高人口密度场所工作或停留的人员，如幼儿园、中小学教师和学生、囚犯和监狱工作人员；其他高风险流感群体，包括 60 岁以上的成年人、 6-59 个月的儿童、特定慢性疾病患者、6 个月以下婴儿的家庭成员和照顾者、孕妇及计划在流感季节期间怀孕的女士。

src: Considering the situation of globally pandemic of COVID-19, to decrease the risk of influenza virus infection and minimize the impact on COVID-19 prevention and control, we recommend the following priority for seasonal influenza vaccination: healthcare workers, including clinical doctors and nurses, public health professionals, quarantine professionals; vulnerable groups living in nursing homes or welfare homes and staffs who take care those vulnerable groups; people work or stay in high population density places, such as teachers and students in kindergartens, primary and secondary school, prisoners and staffs of prisons; other high risk group of influenza, including adults ≥60 years of age, children aged 6-59 months, persons with specific chronic diseases, the family members and caregivers of infants <6 months of age, and pregnant women or women who plan to become pregnant during the influenza season.
tgt: 考虑到COVID-19在全球大流行的情况，为了降低流感病毒感染的风险，最大限度地减少对COVID-19防控的影响，我们建议季节性流感疫苗接种的优先事项如下：医护人员，包括临床医生和护士、公共卫生专业人员、检疫专业人员；生活在养老院或福利院的弱势群体和照顾这些弱势群体的工作人员；在人口密度高的场所工作或逗留的人，如幼儿园、中小学校的教师和学生、监狱的服刑人员和工作人员；其他流感高危人群，包括≥60岁的成年人、6-59个月的儿童、患有特定慢性疾病的人、<6个月婴儿的家庭成员和照顾者、孕妇或计划在流感季节怀孕的妇女。
ref: 考虑到全球 COVID-19 大流行的情势，为了降低流感病毒感染的风险，最大限度地减少对 COVID-19 预防和控制的影响，我们建议季节性流感疫苗的优先接种对象如下：医护人员，包括临床医生和护士、公共卫生专业人员、检疫专业人员；生活在养老院或福利院的弱势群体以及照顾这些弱势群体的工作人员；在高人口密度场所工作或停留的人员，如幼儿园、中小学教师和学生、囚犯和监狱工作人员；其他高风险流感群体，包括 60 岁以上的成年人、 6-59 个月的儿童、特定慢性疾病患者、6 个月以下婴儿的家庭成员和照顾者、孕妇及计划在流感季节期间怀孕的女士。

src: Considering the situation of globally pandemic of COVID-19, to decrease the risk of influenza virus infection and minimize the impact on COVID-19 prevention and control, we recommend the following priority for seasonal influenza vaccination: healthcare workers, including clinical doctors and nurses, public health professionals, quarantine professionals; vulnerable groups living in nursing homes or welfare homes and staffs who take care those vulnerable groups; people work or stay in high population density places, such as teachers and students in kindergartens, primary and secondary school, prisoners and staffs of prisons; other high risk group of influenza, including adults ≥60 years of age, children aged 6-59 months, persons with specific chronic diseases, the family members and caregivers of infants <6 months of age, and pregnant women or women who plan to become pregnant during the influenza season.
tgt: 考虑到COVID-19全球大流行的情况，为了降低流感病毒感染的风险并将对COVID-19防控的影响降至最低，我们建议季节性流感疫苗接种的优先事项如下：卫生保健工作者，包括临床医生和护士、公共卫生专业人员、检疫专业人员；生活在养老院或福利院的弱势群体和照顾这些弱势群体的工作人员；在人口密度高的场所工作或居住的人，如幼儿园、中小学校的教师和学生、服刑人员和监狱工作人员；其他流感高危人群，包括≥60岁的成年人、6-59个月的儿童、患有特定慢性疾病的人、<6个月婴儿的家庭成员和照顾者、孕妇或计划在流感季节怀孕的妇女。

src: Considering the situation of globally pandemic of COVID-19, to decrease the risk of influenza virus infection and minimize the impact on COVID-19 prevention and control, we recommend the following priority for seasonal influenza vaccination: healthcare workers, including clinical doctors and nurses, public health professionals, quarantine professionals; vulnerable groups living in nursing homes or welfare homes and staffs who take care those vulnerable groups; people work or stay in high population density places, such as teachers and students in kindergartens, primary and secondary school, prisoners and staffs of prisons; other high risk group of influenza, including adults ≥60 years of age, children aged 6-59 months, persons with specific chronic diseases, the family members and caregivers of infants <6 months of age, and pregnant women or women who plan to become pregnant during the influenza season.
tgt: 考虑到新冠疫情全球大流行的形势，为了降低流感病毒感染的风险，最大限度地减少对新冠疫情防控的影响，我们建议季节性流感疫苗接种的优先事项如下：医护人员，包括临床医生和护士、公共卫生专业人员、检疫专业人员；居住在疗养院或福利院的弱势群体和照顾这些弱势群体的工作人员；在人口密度高的地方工作或居住的人，如幼儿园、中小学的教师和学生、监狱的囚犯和工作人员；其他流感高危群体，包括≥60岁的成年人、6-59个月的儿童、患有特定慢性病的人、6个月以下婴儿的家庭成员和护理人员，以及孕妇或计划在流感季节怀孕的妇女。
ref: 考虑到全球 COVID-19 大流行的情势，为了降低流感病毒感染的风险，最大限度地减少对 COVID-19 预防和控制的影响，我们建议季节性流感疫苗的优先接种对象如下：医护人员，包括临床医生和护士、公共卫生专业人员、检疫专业人员；生活在养老院或福利院的弱势群体以及照顾这些弱势群体的工作人员；在高人口密度场所工作或停留的人员，如幼儿园、中小学教师和学生、囚犯和监狱工作人员；其他高风险流感群体，包括 60 岁以上的成年人、 6-59 个月的儿童、特定慢性疾病患者、6 个月以下婴儿的家庭成员和照顾者、孕妇及计划在流感季节期间怀孕的女士。

src: Considering the situation of globally pandemic of COVID-19, to decrease the risk of influenza virus infection and minimize the impact on COVID-19 prevention and control, we recommend the following priority for seasonal influenza vaccination: healthcare workers, including clinical doctors and nurses, public health professionals, quarantine professionals; vulnerable groups living in nursing homes or welfare homes and staffs who take care those vulnerable groups; people work or stay in high population density places, such as teachers and students in kindergartens, primary and secondary school, prisoners and staffs of prisons; other high risk group of influenza, including adults ≥60 years of age, children aged 6-59 months, persons with specific chronic diseases, the family members and caregivers of infants <6 months of age, and pregnant women or women who plan to become pregnant during the influenza season.
tgt: 考虑到COVID-19全球大流行形势，为降低流感病毒感染风险，最大限度减少对COVID-19防控的影响，建议优先接种季节性流感疫苗：医护人员，包括临床医生和护士、公共卫生专业人员、检疫专业人员；居住在养老院或福利院的弱势群体和照顾这些弱势群体的工作人员；幼儿园、中小学、监狱的教师和学生等高人口密度场所工作或留宿；其他流感高危群体，包括60岁以上成人、6个月以上儿童、患6个月以上慢性病者、患儿家属和6个月以下的照顾者；孕妇、孕期妇女、孕期妇女、孕期妇女、孕期计划成为流感高危人群。
ref: 考虑到全球 COVID-19 大流行的情势，为了降低流感病毒感染的风险，最大限度地减少对 COVID-19 预防和控制的影响，我们建议季节性流感疫苗的优先接种对象如下：医护人员，包括临床医生和护士、公共卫生专业人员、检疫专业人员；生活在养老院或福利院的弱势群体以及照顾这些弱势群体的工作人员；在高人口密度场所工作或停留的人员，如幼儿园、中小学教师和学生、囚犯和监狱工作人员；其他高风险流感群体，包括 60 岁以上的成年人、 6-59 个月的儿童、特定慢性疾病患者、6 个月以下婴儿的家庭成员和照顾者、孕妇及计划在流感季节期间怀孕的女士。

src: Considering the situation of globally pandemic of COVID-19, to decrease the risk of influenza virus infection and minimize the impact on COVID-19 prevention and control, we recommend the following priority for seasonal influenza vaccination: healthcare workers, including clinical doctors and nurses, public health professionals, quarantine professionals; vulnerable groups living in nursing homes or welfare homes and staffs who take care those vulnerable groups; people work or stay in high population density places, such as teachers and students in kindergartens, primary and secondary school, prisoners and staffs of prisons; other high risk group of influenza, including adults ≥60 years of age, children aged 6-59 months, persons with specific chronic diseases, the family members and caregivers of infants <6 months of age, and pregnant women or women who plan to become pregnant during the influenza season.
tgt: 考虑到新型冠状病毒肺炎（COVID-19）全球大流行的形势，为降低流感病毒感染风险，最大限度地减少对COVID-19防控的影响，建议优先接种季节性流感疫苗：医护人员，包括临床医生和护士、公共卫生专业人员、检疫专业人员；居住在疗养院或福利院的弱势群体和照顾这些弱势群体的工作人员；在人口密度大的场所工作或停留的人员，如幼儿园的教师和学生、中小学、监狱的囚犯和工作人员；其他流感高危人群，包括60岁以上的成年人、6-59个月的儿童、患有特定慢性疾病的人、家属和 < 6个月的婴儿的照顾者，以及在流感流行季节计划期间成为孕妇或孕妇的孕妇。
ref: 考虑到全球 COVID-19 大流行的情势，为了降低流感病毒感染的风险，最大限度地减少对 COVID-19 预防和控制的影响，我们建议季节性流感疫苗的优先接种对象如下：医护人员，包括临床医生和护士、公共卫生专业人员、检疫专业人员；生活在养老院或福利院的弱势群体以及照顾这些弱势群体的工作人员；在高人口密度场所工作或停留的人员，如幼儿园、中小学教师和学生、囚犯和监狱工作人员；其他高风险流感群体，包括 60 岁以上的成年人、 6-59 个月的儿童、特定慢性疾病患者、6 个月以下婴儿的家庭成员和照顾者、孕妇及计划在流感季节期间怀孕的女士。

src: The study aimed to compare two concepts of rurality, one proposed by the Brazilian Institute of Geography and Statistics (IBGE) and the other by the World Bank, to determine which is better fitted to the territory's reality, besides analyzing the infant mortality profile of rural municipalities (counties) in the state of Paraíba, Brazil, according to the best criterion for rurality.

src: The caregivers of 435 children (211 females, 224 males; mean age 12y; SD 3y 11mo; age range 5-18y) with intellectual disability and autism spectrum disorder, cerebral palsy, Down syndrome, or Rett syndrome reported on their child's functioning (dependence for managing personal needs, mobility, communication, eye contact when speaking), frequency of participation, and QoL. Linear regression and mediation analyses were used to evaluate the relationships between child functioning, participation, and QoL. Children with greater dependency for managing personal needs and limited eye contact when speaking experienced poorer QoL. Less impaired functioning was associated with more frequent participation, which, in turn, was associated with a 3-point gain in QoL for each additional point in frequency of participation (coefficient=2.67, 95% confidence interval 1.56-3.78).

src: The caregivers of 435 children (211 females, 224 males; mean age 12y; SD 3y 11mo; age range 5-18y) with intellectual disability and autism spectrum disorder, cerebral palsy, Down syndrome, or Rett syndrome reported on their child's functioning (dependence for managing personal needs, mobility, communication, eye contact when speaking), frequency of participation, and QoL. Linear regression and mediation analyses were used to evaluate the relationships between child functioning, participation, and QoL. Children with greater dependency for managing personal needs and limited eye contact when speaking experienced poorer QoL. Less impaired functioning was associated with more frequent participation, which, in turn, was associated with a 3-point gain in QoL for each additional point in frequency of participation (coefficient=2.67, 95% confidence interval 1.56-3.78).
tgt: Los cuidadores de 435 niños (211 mujeres, 224 varones; edad media de 12años; DE 31,11 meses; rango de edad 5-18 años) con discapacidad intelectual y trastorno del espectro autista, parálisis cerebral, síndrome de Down.
ref: Los cuidadores de 435 niños (211 mujeres, 224 hombres; edad media 12 años; DE de 3 años y 11 meses; intervalo de edad 5-18 años) con discapacidad intelectual y trastorno del espectro autista, parálisis cerebral, síndrome de Down o síndrome de Rett facilitaron información sobre la funcionalidad de sus hijos (dependencia para gestionar necesidades personales, movilidad, comunicación, contacto visual al hablar), la frecuencia de participación y la CdV. Se utilizaron análisis de mediación y regresión lineal para evaluar las relaciones entre la funcionalidad, la participación y la CdV del niño. Los niños con mayor dependencia para gestionar sus necesidades personales y con contacto visual limitado al hablar presentaron una CdV peor. Una funcionalidad menos deteriorada se asoció a una participación más frecuente, lo que, a su vez, se asoció a una ganancia de 3 puntos en la calidad de vida por cada punto adicional en la frecuencia de participación (coeficiente = 2,67, intervalo de confianza al 95 %: 1,56-3,78).

src: The caregivers of 435 children (211 females, 224 males; mean age 12y; SD 3y 11mo; age range 5-18y) with intellectual disability and autism spectrum disorder, cerebral palsy, Down syndrome, or Rett syndrome reported on their child's functioning (dependence for managing personal needs, mobility, communication, eye contact when speaking), frequency of participation, and QoL. Linear regression and mediation analyses were used to evaluate the relationships between child functioning, participation, and QoL. Children with greater dependency for managing personal needs and limited eye contact when speaking experienced poorer QoL. Less impaired functioning was associated with more frequent participation, which, in turn, was associated with a 3-point gain in QoL for each additional point in frequency of participation (coefficient=2.67, 95% confidence interval 1.56-3.78).

src: The caregivers of 435 children (211 females, 224 males; mean age 12y; SD 3y 11mo; age range 5-18y) with intellectual disability and autism spectrum disorder, cerebral palsy, Down syndrome, or Rett syndrome reported on their child's functioning (dependence for managing personal needs, mobility, communication, eye contact when speaking), frequency of participation, and QoL. Linear regression and mediation analyses were used to evaluate the relationships between child functioning, participation, and QoL. Children with greater dependency for managing personal needs and limited eye contact when speaking experienced poorer QoL. Less impaired functioning was associated with more frequent participation, which, in turn, was associated with a 3-point gain in QoL for each additional point in frequency of participation (coefficient=2.67, 95% confidence interval 1.56-3.78).
tgt: Los cuidadores de 435 niños (211 mujeres, 224 hombres; edad media de 12 años; DE de 3 años 11 meses; rango de edad de 5-18 años) con discapacidad intelectual y trastorno del espectro autista, parálisis cerebral, síndrome de Down o síndrome de Rett informaron sobre el funcionamiento de su hijo (dependencia para el manejo de las necesidades personales, movilidad, comunicación, contacto oftalmológico al hablar), frecuencia de participación y la CV. La regresión lineal entre los medios fue la gestión de la calidad de vida.
ref: Los cuidadores de 435 niños (211 mujeres, 224 hombres; edad media 12 años; DE de 3 años y 11 meses; intervalo de edad 5-18 años) con discapacidad intelectual y trastorno del espectro autista, parálisis cerebral, síndrome de Down o síndrome de Rett facilitaron información sobre la funcionalidad de sus hijos (dependencia para gestionar necesidades personales, movilidad, comunicación, contacto visual al hablar), la frecuencia de participación y la CdV. src: The caregivers of 435 children (211 females, 224 males; mean age 12y; SD 3y 11mo; age range 5-18y) with intellectual disability and autism spectrum disorder, cerebral palsy, Down syndrome, or Rett syndrome reported on their child's functioning (dependence for managing personal needs, mobility, communication, eye contact when speaking), frequency of participation, and QoL. Linear regression and mediation analyses were used to evaluate the relationships between child functioning, participation, and QoL. Children with greater dependency for managing personal needs and limited eye contact when speaking experienced poorer QoL. Less impaired functioning was associated with more frequent participation, which, in turn, was associated with a 3-point gain in QoL for each additional point in frequency of participation (coefficient=2.67, 95% confidence interval 1.56-3.78).
tgt: Los cuidadores de 435 niños (211 mujeres, 224 hombres; edad media de 12 años; DE de 3 años 11 meses; rango de edad de 5 a 18 años) con discapacidad intelectual y trastorno del espectro autista, parálisis cerebral, síndrome de Down o síndrome de Rett informaron sobre el funcionamiento de su hijo (dependencia para el manejo de las necesidades personales, movilidad, comunicación, contacto ocular al hablar), frecuencia de la participación y de la CdV. La relación lineal entre la capacidad de respuesta y la capacidad de respuesta fue de respuesta de los pacientes.
ref: Los cuidadores de 435 niños (211 mujeres, 224 hombres; edad media 12 años; DE de 3 años y 11 meses; intervalo de edad 5-18 años) con discapacidad intelectual y trastorno del espectro autista, parálisis cerebral, síndrome de Down o síndrome de Rett facilitaron información sobre la funcionalidad de sus hijos (dependencia para gestionar necesidades personales, movilidad, comunicación, contacto visual al hablar), la frecuencia de participación y la CdV. Se utilizaron análisis de mediación y regresión lineal para evaluar las relaciones entre la funcionalidad, la participación y la CdV del niño. Los niños con mayor dependencia para gestionar sus necesidades personales y con contacto visual limitado al hablar presentaron una CdV peor. Una funcionalidad menos deteriorada se asoció a una participación más frecuente, lo que, a su vez, se asoció a una ganancia de 3 puntos en la calidad de vida por cada punto adicional en la frecuencia de participación (coeficiente = 2,67, intervalo de confianza al 95 %: 1,56-3,78).

src: In girls, it was observed that those who did not meet the guidelines presented a lower probability of eating one piece of fruit (OR = 0.43; 95 % CI = 0.19-0.99) as well as a second piece (OR = 0.22; 95 % CI = 0.22-0.81), vegetables more than once a day (OR = 0.39; 95 % CI = 0.19-0.80), fish (at least 2-3 times/week) (OR = 0.40; 95 % CI = 0.20-0.78) and nuts (at least 2 or 3 times per week) (OR = 0.46; 95 % = 0.24-0.87). src: The caregivers of 435 children (211 females, 224 males; mean age 12y; SD 3y 11mo; age range 5-18y) with intellectual disability and autism spectrum disorder, cerebral palsy, Down syndrome, or Rett syndrome reported on their child's functioning (dependence for managing personal needs, mobility, communication, eye contact when speaking), frequency of participation, and QoL. Linear regression and mediation analyses were used to evaluate the relationships between child functioning, participation, and QoL. Children with greater dependency for managing personal needs and limited eye contact when speaking experienced poorer QoL. Less impaired functioning was associated with more frequent participation, which, in turn, was associated with a 3-point gain in QoL for each additional point in frequency of participation (coefficient=2.67, 95% confidence interval 1.56-3.78).
tgt: Los cuidadores de 435 niños (211 mujeres, 224 hombres; edad media 12 años; SD 3 años 11 meses; rango de edad 5-18 años) con discapacidad intelectual y trastorno del espectro autista, parálisis cerebral, síndrome de Down o síndrome de Rett informaron sobre el funcionamiento de sus hijos (dependencia para gestionar necesidades personales, movilidad, comunicación, contacto visual al hablar), frecuencia de participación y CdV. Se utilizaron análisis de mediación y regresión lineal para evaluar las relaciones entre el funcionamiento, la participación y la CdV del niño. Los niños con mayor dependencia para manejar sus necesidades personales y contacto visual limitado al hablar experimentaron una CdV más pobre. Un funcionamiento menos deteriorado se asoció con una participación más frecuente, lo que, a su vez, se asoció con una ganancia de 3 puntos en la calidad de vida por cada punto adicional en la frecuencia de participación (coeficiente = 2,67, intervalo de confianza del 95 %: 1,56-3,78).
ref: Los cuidadores de 435 niños (211 mujeres, 224 hombres; edad media 12 años; DE de 3 años y 11 meses; intervalo de edad 5-18 años) con discapacidad intelectual y trastorno del espectro autista, parálisis cerebral, síndrome de Down o síndrome de Rett facilitaron información sobre la funcionalidad de sus hijos (dependencia para gestionar necesidades personales, movilidad, comunicación, contacto visual al hablar), la frecuencia de participación y la CdV. Se utilizaron análisis de mediación y regresión lineal para evaluar las relaciones entre la funcionalidad, la participación y la CdV del niño. Los niños con mayor dependencia para gestionar sus necesidades personales y con contacto visual limitado al hablar presentaron una CdV peor. src: Considering the situation of globally pandemic of COVID-19, to decrease the risk of influenza virus infection and minimize the impact on COVID-19 prevention and control, we recommend the following priority for seasonal influenza vaccination: healthcare workers, including clinical doctors and nurses, public health professionals, quarantine professionals; vulnerable groups living in nursing homes or welfare homes and staffs who take care those vulnerable groups; people work or stay in high population density places, such as teachers and students in kindergartens, primary and secondary school, prisoners and staffs of prisons; other high risk group of influenza, including adults ≥60 years of age, children aged 6-59 months, persons with specific chronic diseases, the family members and caregivers of infants <6 months of age, and pregnant women or women who plan to become pregnant during the influenza season.
tgt: 考虑到全球 COVID-19 大流行的情势，为了降低流感病毒感染的风险，最大限度地减少对 COVID-19 预防和控制的影响，我们建议季节性流感疫苗的优先接种对象如下：医护人员，包括临床医生和护士、公共卫生专业人员、检疫专业人员；生活在养老院或福利院的弱势群体以及照顾这些弱势群体的工作人员；在高人口密度场所工作或停留的人员，如幼儿园、中小学教师和学生、囚犯和监狱工作人员；其他高风险流感群体，包括 60 岁以上的成年人、 6-59 个月的儿童、特定慢性疾病患者、6 个月以下婴儿的家庭成员和照顾者、孕妇及计划在流感季节期间怀孕的女士。

src: Considering the situation of globally pandemic of COVID-19, to decrease the risk of influenza virus infection and minimize the impact on COVID-19 prevention and control, we recommend the following priority for seasonal influenza vaccination: healthcare workers, including clinical doctors and nurses, public health professionals, quarantine professionals; vulnerable groups living in nursing homes or welfare homes and staffs who take care those vulnerable groups; people work or stay in high population density places, such as teachers and students in kindergartens, primary and secondary school, prisoners and staffs of prisons; other high risk group of influenza, including adults ≥60 years of age, children aged 6-59 months, persons with specific chronic diseases, the family members and caregivers of infants <6 months of age, and pregnant women or women who plan to become pregnant during the influenza season.
tgt: 考虑到全球 COVID-19 大流行的情势，为了降低流感病毒感染的风险，最大限度地减少对 COVID-19 预防和控制的影响，我们建议季节性流感疫苗的优先接种对象如下：医护人员，包括临床医生和护士，公共卫生专业人员，检疫专业人员；生活在养老院或福利院的弱势群体以及照顾这些弱势群体的工作人员；在高人口密度场所工作或停留的人员，如幼儿园，中小学的教师和学生，囚犯和监狱工作人员；其他高风险流感群体，包括 60 岁以上的成年人， 6-59 个月的儿童，特定慢性疾病患者， 6 个月以下婴儿的家庭成员和照顾者，孕妇及计划在流感季节期间怀孕的女士。

src: The caregivers of 435 children (211 females, 224 males; mean age 12y; SD 3y 11mo; age range 5-18y) with intellectual disability and autism spectrum disorder, cerebral palsy, Down syndrome, or Rett syndrome reported on their child's functioning (dependence for managing personal needs, mobility, communication, eye contact when speaking), frequency of participation, and QoL. Linear regression and mediation analyses were used to evaluate the relationships between child functioning, participation, and QoL. Children with greater dependency for managing personal needs and limited eye contact when speaking experienced poorer QoL. Less impaired functioning was associated with more frequent participation, which, in turn, was associated with a 3-point gain in QoL for each additional point in frequency of participation (coefficient=2.67, 95% confidence interval 1.56-3.78).
tgt: Los cuidadores de 435 niños (211 mujeres, 224 hombres; edad media 12 años; DE de 3 años y 11 meses; intervalo de edad 5-18 años) con discapacidad intelectual y trastorno del espectro autista, parálisis cerebral, síndrome de Down o síndrome de Rett facilitaron información sobre la funcionalidad de sus hijos (dependencia para gestionar necesidades personales, movilidad, comunicación, contacto visual al hablar), la frecuencia de participación y la CdV. Se utilizaron análisis de mediación y regresión lineal para evaluar las relaciones entre la funcionalidad, la participación y la CdV del niño.
